title: Charges under an Open Billing-Error Dispute and the Desk Minimum — Crestline Credit Card
content:
A charge under an open billing-error dispute is left out of the minimum the Crestline care desk takes on the latest Crestline Credit Card statement: when a dispute submitted to the bank is open on a charge carried in the statement's balance, that is a purchase posted on or before the statement's closing date, whatever cycle it posted in, or a fee posted on or before that date other than the late fee posted in the statement's cycle and with no fee reversal standing against it, the product's percentage of that charge, rounded up to the cent, is taken off; when the open dispute is on the late fee posted in the statement's cycle and no fee reversal stands against that fee, the fee is taken off; otherwise nothing is taken off for disputes. This is figured for an account with at most one billing-error dispute open.

The late fee posted in the statement's cycle is the most recent late fee, when it was posted on or before the statement's closing date and charged for the statement that closed immediately before it, no more than 31 days earlier.

| Product | Percentage |
|---|---|
| Crestline Auto Care Card Starter | 3.5% |
| Crestline Auto Care Card | 3.5% |
| Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred | 3.25% |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard | 3% |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred | 3% |
| Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard | 2.75% |

## Records read

- the billing-dispute request submitted to the bank and still open, and the ledger entry it disputes (its kind — purchase, late fee or returned payment fee — its amount and its posting date);
- any fee reversal on the card ledger citing that entry.

## Decision table

| Disputed entry | Posted on or before the closing date | Fee reversal standing against it | Taken off the minimum |
|---|---|---|---|
| a purchase, from any cycle | yes | — | the percentage of the purchase, rounded up to the cent |
| a fee other than the cycle's late fee | yes | no | the percentage of the fee, rounded up to the cent |
| the late fee posted in the statement's cycle | yes | no | the whole fee |
| any fee | — | yes | nothing |
| any entry posted after the closing date | no | — | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical, 3% product)

- Open dispute on a 640.00 USD tire purchase posted two cycles earlier: 19.20 USD is taken off.
- Open dispute on the cycle's 27.00 USD late fee, no reversal: 27.00 USD is taken off.
- Open dispute on a returned payment fee that already carries a reversal: nothing is taken off.
